name: Japan

flag.description: A white rectangular field with a single red disc in the exact centre.
flag.symbolism: The red disc represents the sun, reflecting the country's name, Nihon, often translated as "origin of the sun".

hook: Japan's red sun sits dead centre on white; Bangladesh puts its red disc off-centre on green, and Palau has a yellow moon on blue.
trivia: The flag is called the Hinomaru, "circle of the sun".
It was used as a merchant flag from 1870, but only became the legally designated national flag in 1999, when its proportions were fixed and the disc was placed exactly in the centre.
